posts.title: Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse - How to Solve the Secret Organ Melody
posts.summary: When venturing across Notre Dame in Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, you will find that Death has locked himself behind three life-draining beams. All three beams will require you to play a specific melody on the Great Organ in order to deactivate them. But there is a fourth melody for you to discover.

posts.title: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand - Official Demo Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
